lessons.summary: Sometimes we need to include special characters or formatting inside a string. Java provides escape sequences for this purpose.

lessons.title: String Methods
lessons.summary: Java provides several built-in methods that make working with strings easier. Instead of writing the logic ourselves, we can call these methods whenever we need them.

blocks.content: Java provides several built-in methods that make working with strings easier. Instead of writing the logic ourselves, we can call these methods whenever we need them.
In this section, we'll explore four useful string methods:

- length() → counts the characters in a string
- charAt() → gets a character at a specific position
- concat() → combines two strings
- equals() → checks whether two strings are equal
We'll begin with the length() method and learn how it counts characters in a string.
